item.title: We cut our Mongo DB costs by 90% by moving to Hetzner
item.description:
📝 Starting with MongoDB Atlas for Free but Scaling Costs Added UpWhen we first started building, MongoDB Atlas was an easy choice. The cost breakdown before we migrated looked roughly like this:ServiceMonthly CostAtlas M40 Instance - AWS$1000Atlas Continuous Cloud Backup Storage$700Atlas AWS Data Transfer (Same Region)$10Atlas AWS Data Transfer (Different Region)$1Atlas AWS Data Transfer (Internet)$1,000❗Total + VAT$3000+The more keen eyed among you will have noticed the huge cost associated with data transfer over the internet - its as much as the servers. However, MongoDB Atlas wouldn't let us kill the connections using admin shell commands.
🔗 Read more: https://prosopo.io/blog/we-cut-our-mongodb-costs-by-90-percent/
